title: Kerala govt expresses displeasure to Adani Ports over Vizhinjam port deal with MSC
description: The Kerala government has expressed its displeasure to Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone (APSEZ) Limited for not informing it before publicly announcing the sale of a 49% stake in the Vizhinjam port to Mediterranean Shipping Company (MSC), a statement from the chief minister’s office said on Thursday
